verdict.rationale: The evidence offers no first-party scheduled or recurring workflow feature. What it does show are developer building blocks: webhooks that POST change events to an engineer-hosted endpoint, a REST API and internal connections described as 'ideal for custom automations', and Skills, which are instruction pages for repeatable workflows but have no documented trigger or schedule. The vague 'Keep work moving 24/7 with agents' marketing line does not document any scheduling or recurring trigger, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work
